implementationInquiry.storage: SendToAgent is projected as a sender assistant/toAgent row and a recipient user/fromAgent row; the compact event and read-only exchange are derived by the desktop renderer.
implementationInquiry.selection: activeSession plus ACTIVE_AGENT owns selection. Background A2A, routine, event, ACK-redrive, and Task-completion wakes use resolveBackgroundSession plus beginSessionRun and do not call switchAgent or setActiveSession.
implementationInquiry.taskChildren: Task children have no sidebar row. A parent remains Working while any live Task, shell, or cloud child belongs to it.
implementationInquiry.working: isRunning is the union of active parent-turn counts and liveSubagentParentIds; a queued inbound message alone is not Working.
implementationInquiry.confidence: Reported by a live Grokbot agent after implementation inspection; the exact private renderer collapse function was not available to that agent.

modelFacingWake.probeWake:
[SAND_HIDDEN_PROMPT][agent] A message just arrived from another of your user's agents: A2A UI Source 2330 (id: 1abdfef4-d9a0-44c2-9690-31019324de09).
This is another assistant reaching out — not the user typing here. It arrived asynchronously, and your user can already see it in this chat.

A2A UI Source 2330: OPENBOT_DEFINITIVE_OVERLAP_A2A_20260827_2355 — reply with exactly ACK OPENBOT_DEFINITIVE_OVERLAP_A2A_20260827_2355

If it needs a reply or an action, handle it: reply to A2A UI Source 2330 with SendToAgent (their id: 1abdfef4-d9a0-44c2-9690-31019324de09), which reaches them on a later turn — not a live back-and-forth — and use SendToUser to tell your user only when you have a real result to share. If it is just an FYI with nothing for you to do, it is fine to stay silent — no need to reply just to acknowledge it.
modelFacingWake.transportEnvelope: The Pi session wraps the wake in the normal <timestamp><user_query> envelope; the A2A wake body itself matches Grokbot's observed prompt.
modelFacingWake.routineVariant: When routines exist, directAgentWake prepends Grokbot's <system_reminder><automation_status> block before the [agent] paragraph.

selectionRestoreRace.cause: An asynchronous saved-active-agent restore could overwrite a newer user selection.
selectionRestoreRace.fix: Selection revisions now reject a late restore after any newer user selection and persist the user choice immediately.
tests: saved active agent restores when selection is untouched
late restore cannot steal a newer user selection
an unavailable saved agent preserves the current selection

parentWorkingDuringChildTask.cause: The sidebar derived Working only from parent runs and ignored active child attempts.
parentWorkingDuringChildTask.fix: Sidebar Working is now the union of an active parent run and active provisioning, queued, or running child attempts for that parent channel.
tests: parent stays Working after its own run completes while its child is active
parent clears after the child settles

uiAssertions: The unrelated New Bot parent displayed Working after its own run completed because its executor child was still live.
The A2A source stayed selected during outbound delivery, probe reply, source ACK wake, child completion, and the hidden parent completion wake.
The source and probe Working states cleared when their runs completed while the unrelated parent remained Working.
The source home displayed one compact 2 messages with A2A UI Probe 2330 event and Complete.
The hidden child-completion wake completed without changing the selected chat; New Bot then cleared Working.

earlierUiObservationReclassified.reason: The earlier capture mixed a late active-agent restore race with genuine later background wakes. Controlled SSE runs updated and cleared all Working states without a reload after the selection fix.
